cobblemon.species.averi.name: Averi
cobblemon.species.averi.desc1: This Pokemon is frequently seen assisting Meowscarada with magic tricks. It is happy to help, as long as it's not eaten.
cobblemon.species.averi.desc2: Trainers appear to be happier when nearby this pokemon. Some theorise it has an aura of happiness, others think it's very cute.
cobblemon.species.averon.name: Averon
cobblemon.species.averon.desc1: Having grown in size from Averi, this Pokemon is now able to defend other Pokemon, assist in transportation and provide better hugs.
cobblemon.species.averon.desc2: The ball above its head grows if nearby trainers or Pokemon are happy. This Pokemon was already kind, but now always aims to improve the lives of those around it
cobblemon.species.averist.name: Averist
cobblemon.species.averist.desc1: This Pokemon absorbed energy from its kind acts, providing it new power. It continues to help people, despite not gaining more power.
cobblemon.species.averist.desc2: This Pokémon can use its psychic abilities to share ideas with humans. It's commonly seen near Absol, guiding those in danger
cobblemon.species.baitellapup.name: Baitellapup
cobblemon.species.lupsostrial.name: Lupsostrial
cobblemon.species.selcanirave.name: Selcanirave
cobblemon.species.ryuka.name: Ryuka
cobblemon.species.rymodel.name: Rymodel
cobblemon.species.ryunit.name: Ryunit
cobblemon.species.ryunit.desc: The finalized version of this anti pokemon defense unit, due to a fatal flaw in its programming once its energy depletes the fossil reawakens, becoming a rampaging beast that can cause more destruction than an enraged Gyarados.
cobblemon.species.budjolt.name: Budjolt
cobblemon.species.budjolt.desc: To protect itself from predators, it flies in massive flocks that generate tremendous electrical charges. It's sociable but mischievous.
cobblemon.species.shockatiel.name: Shockatiel
cobblemon.species.shockatiel.desc: The bright crest on its head gathers and stores ambient electricity that it discharges at will. It delights in loud noises and will often loudly taunt larger Pokemon.
cobblemon.species.raucatoo.name: Raucatoo
cobblemon.species.raucatoo.desc: Its voice booms like thunder, and with the flashing of its electrified crest this Pokemon's presence is impossible to ignore. While it is rebellious by nature, a patient Trainer may find its attention-seeking antics endearing.
cobblemon.species.crepitule.name: Crepitule
cobblemon.species.crepitule.desc: Crepitule's flames are created by two chemicals stored in its abdomen, despite the quantity produced it rarely ignites.
cobblemon.species.flammentle.name: Flammentle
cobblemon.species.flammentle.desc: Frustrated by the weakness of their firepower, Flammentles often take out their anger on weaker Pokémon and stand up to their trainers.
cobblemon.species.blazeufel.name: Blazeufel
cobblemon.species.blazeufel.desc: Upon evolving, Blazeufel's chemical makeup becomes poisonous and highly flammable. They often coat themselves and their territory with it to enhance their fire attacks.
cobblemon.species.geomite.name: Geomite
cobblemon.species.geomite.desc: A small skittish Pokemon, that grows faceted, gem-like clusters on its back. When frightened, it tucks its legs beneath its rocky shell to disguise itself as an ordinary, immovable pebble.
cobblemon.species.arachnolith.name: Arachnolith
cobblemon.species.arachnolith.desc: As a patient ambush predator, it spins intricate, near-invisible silk traps across narrow pathways. It lies perfectly motionless in the shadows, waiting to strike the moment unsuspecting prey becomes ensnared.
cobblemon.species.terrachne.name: Terrachne
cobblemon.species.terrachne.desc: Layers of natural stone cover Terrachne's body, forming a armor-like shell that grows throughout its life. Once prey is trapped in its webs, it uses its enormous crystal-tipped armored forelimbs to crush and impale its victims with overwhelming force.
cobblemon.move.current.desc: The user creates a powerful current that increases the power of moves used by the user and its allies. Can only be used if there are no weather conditions.
cobblemon.move.crystallinesnare.desc: User attacks the opposing Pokémon and applies webbed, lowering the target's Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
cobblemon.ability.backunit.desc: If the Pokemon has electric type it will have levitate. Once it loses its electric type, its physical and special stats will be swapped and it loses levitation.
cobblemon.ability.chemical.desc: The pokémon's fire attacks are powered by a poisonous chemical, they may leave the target poisoned.
